title: UNIOSUN 2026/27 Admission List, Acceptance Fee, Cut-Offs & Student Portal
summary: Osun State University has released its 2026/27 UTME merit admission list. Candidates who screened can check results and admission status in the university's official admissions portal. The university specifies a ₦65,000 acceptance fee for admitted candidates. This is distinct from the expired ₦3,000 portal-access and ₦2,000 screening charges and from school tuition.
feeNote: The UNIOSUN merit-list release explicitly sets ₦65,000 as the provisional admission acceptance fee. The 2026 screening advert separately charged ₦3,000 portal access plus ₦2,000 Post-UTME screening (₦5,000 combined); these are historic application charges and NOT acceptance fees or annual tuition. A programme-level 2026/27 school-fee or hostel amount was not supplied in the checked official notices. Pay only the matching current university-generated invoice after verifying admission.
timeline: 2026/27 Post-UTME registration closed at noon on 17 September 2026; Direct Entry transcript submission was due on 4 September 2026. The university has since announced that the UTME merit admission list and 2026 screening results are available in its official portal. The release does not establish a single acceptance-payment deadline, so check the admitted candidate's notice.
requirements: Candidates should have chosen UNIOSUN as first choice, or changed to first choice, and met the university's general 2026 UTME minimum of 160; programmes including Law, Nursing and Islamic Law had a minimum 200 threshold for consideration in the original notice.
The original 2026 advert said Medicine admission was on hold for 2026/27. Do not treat the programme threshold alone as proof that Medicine offers are being made.

At least five relevant O-level credits: generally no more than two sittings, but Law, Nursing, Islamic Law and Medicine require one sitting under the official screening notice. JAMB CAPS O-level upload is compulsory.
An applicant account and valid 2026 JAMB registration details to retrieve the 2026 screening result or merit admission status. Direct Entry candidates also follow JAMB DE and transcript requirements.
steps: Open UNIOSUN's 2026/27 UTME merit admission-list notice; the university directs candidates to its official undergraduate admissions portal rather than a third-party PDF list.

At admissions.uniosun.edu.ng choose Returning Applicants, select the correct application type and sign in with your actual screening registration details to check the 2026 screening result and merit admission status.

Compare the university's admission decision with the candidate's JAMB CAPS account, including O-level upload and acceptance of an actual offer; a portal result alone is not a substitute for the JAMB record.
If provisionally admitted, read the admission and personal payment instructions inside the university-owned account; the official published acceptance charge is ₦65,000 for 2026/27 merit admission.
Generate the matching authorised acceptance invoice and pay only through the university-approved payment route; save the completed receipt. Do not accidentally repay the closed 2026 screening fee.

For academic school fees, hostel allocation, health screening and clearance, follow the admitted student's current campus, college and programme instructions, using the separate undergraduate students portal when activated.

If not on the merit list, check later official university communications rather than relying on agents offering admission slots. The general minimum 160 is not a guaranteed departmental admission score.
notes: The university's primary announcement confirms the 2026/27 UTME merit list and the ₦65,000 acceptance fee; this page does not pretend that everyone who met screening criteria was admitted.
The 2026/27 screening advert said 160 generally, 200 for Law/Nursing/Islamic Law, and explicitly put Medicine admission on hold for the session.
The registration stage ended 17 September; it should not be described as currently open merely because a portal still shows New Applicants or offers a login.
UNIOSUN also published a separate approved 2026/27 programme cut-off document. The admission list and departmental marks should always be checked from the current official university notice.
Do not conflate the admissions portal with the post-admission undergraduate students portal; university admission, acceptance, tuition and clearance are separate actions.

title: UNIJOS 2026/27 Post-UTME, Direct Entry, Portal, Fees & Admission Status
summary: University of Jos published a first-choice 2026/27 UTME/Direct Entry screening invitation with a minimum 180 UTME score and a registration period of 13 July to 12 September 2026. Its instructions cover creating a portal account, verifying email, paying the university's own screening invoice, printing both a portal and Remita receipt, and checking a genuine JAMB CAPS admission. No new October screening window was confirmed.
feeLabel: Screening: use official invoice; 2026/27 window ended
feeNote: The signed university web notice instructs candidates to pay the stipulated 2026/27 screening charge through the applicant dashboard but does not give a reliable numeric charge. The university portal's public landing page still advertises a 2023 screening activity, so older portal amounts and dated labels must NOT be reused for 2026/27. Tuition, acceptance and hostels are separate invoices generated for the admitted student's course and session.
timeline: The Registrar's 10 July 2026 notice set registration for Monday 13 July through Saturday 12 September 2026; that application window is past. The notice says candidates should accept a real JAMB CAPS offer within four weeks of its release before expecting the offer on the university portal. No official 2026/27 supplementary date is inferred.
requirements: University of Jos as first-choice institution on the candidate's 2026 JAMB UTME or Direct Entry record.

At least 180 UTME for the general screening route, with more selective courses governed by department-specific qualifying scores. Its posted detailed cut-off table is headed 2025/26 inside a 2026/27 announcement; do not silently treat that old table as newly certified 2026/27 programme scores.
Relevant O-level results must be uploaded to JAMB CAPS; DE candidates need the higher qualification and individual course entry requirements.
Applicant-controlled email, phone number, password and genuine JAMB registration number for university portal registration, plus verified email access for activation.
steps: Read the 10 July 2026 UNIJOS 2026/27 screening notice and verify first-choice status, general UTME 180 minimum and the university's current departmental cut-off guidance.
Do not attempt to pay for an assumed open application: the published screening registration closed on 12 September 2026. Confirm an official extension or new exercise before any fresh application.
For applicants who submitted on time, open portal.unijos.edu.ng, use the relevant Forms Application / 2026 UTME-DE Screening workflow and sign in to their original portal account.

Where the official application permitted submission, the university instructed applicants to enter their JAMB registration number, supply email/phone/password, then activate the account from the email confirmation link.

The university's original workflow then took candidates through the portal Make Payment screen, a successful Remita payment and printing both the portal and Remita receipts; those are screening documents, not university school-fee receipts.
Print the completed screening summary for your own record and check the admissions status using the university-issued account and JAMB CAPS.
Only accept an actual admission offer in CAPS when it appears. UNIJOS's 2026 notice advises accepting a CAPS offer within four weeks of release for the university portal to reflect the decision.
After admission, follow separate session-specific student clearance, tuition and course-registration notices; do not pay a copied 2023 screening amount or a third-party adviser.
notes: The university's 2026/27 announcement is specific to first-choice candidates and the July–September 2026 screening period, not a statement that applications remain open.

The embedded differential course-cutoff table is labelled 2025/26 despite the 2026/27 headline. Treat only the clearly stated 2026 minimum of 180 as securely dated for this guide, and verify newer course requirements directly.
The public student portal home currently displays a stale 2023 screening card. The canonical university 2026 notice takes precedence over the old card for admission dates and fees.
Remita receipt and university screening receipt are distinct from undergraduate acceptance and school charges. No guaranteed 2026/27 tuition amount was established by the primary screening notice.

title: UNIZIK 2026/27 Undergraduate Admission Portal, Screening Status & School Fees
summary: Nnamdi Azikiwe University (UNIZIK), Awka, published its 2026 undergraduate Post-UTME screening information. The official apply.unizik.edu.ng registration screen currently says applications are closed and new applicant account creation is unavailable. Existing applicants can sign in, check eligibility and use the university's separate student/clearance portal routes; do not reuse last year's ₦2,000 screening fee as a confirmed 2026 amount.
feeLabel: Current 2026 screening and tuition fees: not confirmed
feeNote: The official 2025/26 university notice listed a ₦2,000 screening application fee; it is NOT evidence of a 2026/27 fee. The 2026 university announcement points to updated registration guidelines, while the current applicant portal says applications are closed. No source-verified 2026/27 undergraduate screening price, acceptance amount, programme tuition or hostel rate was established. Only authenticated university invoices should control payment.
timeline: UNIZIK posted a 2026 Post-UTME guidelines notice in May 2026 and listed a 2026/27 admission-screening event for 14 July. As of 12 October 2026 the official sign-up page says applications are closed. A generic university admissions webpage separately advertises 2027/28 opening while displaying a contradictory 2026 date calendar; do not treat that generic page as proof of current 2026/27 or 2027/28 account-opening windows.
requirements: A valid JAMB UTME/Direct Entry record and the correct university/programme choice; programme-specific JAMB and O-level eligibility must be checked on the UNIZIK application/eligibility portal rather than relying on an assumed universal cutoff.
An applicant-owned reachable email or phone and matching JAMB registration number for any authorised admission account or password-reset request.
O-level and UTME subject combinations meeting the selected department's criteria; existing applicants can use the platform's eligibility check.
An actual approved university/JAMB CAPS admission offer before beginning acceptance, hostel or student clearance payments.
steps: Open the university's official 2026 Post-UTME guidelines announcement and read any attached notice; do not assume an older session's application fee or deadline applies.
Check apply.unizik.edu.ng/auth/signup: the current official applicant screen explicitly says the application deadline has passed and new account creation is closed.
If you previously registered, use the original UNIZIK sign-in rather than trying to create a new identity; use its email/phone password-reset process when needed.

For application eligibility queries, use the UNIZIK-owned Check Eligibility route and enter only your own JAMB registration details; check official course prerequisites and any result-upload instructions.
Confirm an admission outcome using UNIZIK's authorised communication and JAMB CAPS. An old applicant email or payment slip is not an offer of admission.

After official admission, start at UNIZIK's Portals & Online Services page to locate its current Undergraduate Admission Onboarding, Student Portal, Clearance Portal and NAU Hostel services; these are not the same as the Post-UTME signup site.

Generate a personal, current-session acceptance, tuition or accommodation invoice in the exact authorised university service. Confirm the beneficiary and receipt; never pay an individual to open a closed screening window.
notes: The official application site shows conflicting signup text ('application process is yet to start' and 'Applications are closed'); its unambiguous lock on new account creation means no new screening window can be claimed without university clarification.

The university's May 27, 2026 Post-UTME notice is real, but most detailed requirements are on an attached image. Avoid inventing new dates, fee amounts or departmental marks not recoverable from reliable primary text.

An official generic admissions webpage mentions '2027/2028 admissions open' alongside a 2026 calendar. The contradictory sessions are not a reason to assume UNIZIK admissions are accepting new applications in October 2026.
The 2025/26 university notice explains a historical ₦2,000 fee. It must not be repeated as 2026/27 tuition or screening cost.
The Portals & Online Services directory separates undergraduate applications, admission onboarding, clearance, student account and hostel services.
